last_quiz.subject: ENGLISH
last_quiz.question: Select the sentence in which the word "prudent" is used correctly.

options.A: It was prudent of him to ignore the warning signs.
options.B: The prudent weather made the picnic enjoyable.
options.C: She felt prudent after winning the lottery.
options.D: His prudent attitude won him many awards.

last_quiz.explanation: "Prudent" means showing careful good judgment. Ignoring warning signs demonstrates lack of prudence, so A is incorrect. The correct usage is: "It was prudent of him to ignore the warning signs" – meaning his decision was wise despite the risk.
